driverChargeNone: No charges recorded for this driver.
driverChargeLoadError: Charges could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
driverChargeNoEvidence: No evidence listed. The charge relies on the linked record.
driverChargeSignatureHidden: The signature image is not shown for your access level.
driverChargeCapLine: No monthly instalment may exceed {percent}% of the wage.
driverChargeAppealPending: Waiting for a decision by someone who did not issue or review this charge.
driverChargePdfFailed: The notice PDF could not be created. Try again.
driverChargeStatementLanguage: Language of the statement you sign
driverChargeStatementReadAloud: If you cannot read this, ask your supervisor to read it to you before you sign.
driverChargePhotosNone: No photos attached to this charge.
driverChargePhotosSeen: Look at the photos before you answer.
driverChargeKsaRule: Saudi Labour Law applies to this charge. Damage or loss: at most 5 days of wage each month. Fines: at most 5 days of wage. All deductions together: at most half the wage. You have 15 working days to object.
driverChargeOtherRule: The company limit applies to this charge. This rule still needs legal confirmation for this country.
driverChargeStatementConsent: I am the driver named on this paper. I have seen this charge: the reason, the amount, and the evidence and photos shown with it. I agree that I must pay this charge. I agree that the company may take this amount from my salary, a part each month, as shown on the deduction plan. This agreement is only for this charge. I can still object within the time written on this paper.
driverChargeStatementDispute: I am the driver named on this paper. I have received this charge and I have seen the reason, the evidence and the photos. I do not agree with this charge, for the reasons I wrote. My signature only shows that I received this paper. It does not mean that I agree. I can object within the time written on this paper.
driverChargeStatementWitness: I saw this charge paper given to the driver named on it. The driver did not want to sign it or answer. The date and time of this record are set by the system.
driverChargeStatementMissing: The statement could not be loaded. Refresh before signing.
driverChargeAcknowledge: I have read this statement and I agree to sign it.
driverChargeExplanation: Why do you dispute this charge?
driverChargeAppealOnce: You can appeal a charge only once. The appeal is decided by someone who did not issue or approve it.
driverChargeIssueExplanation: Write at least 10 characters explaining why you dispute the charge.
driverChargeIssueAck: Confirm that you have read the statement.
driverChargeIssueReason: Write at least 10 characters for the appeal.
driverChargeOffline: You are offline. A charge response is recorded only online, so nothing was saved. Connect and try again.
driverChargeSaved: Your response was recorded with the server time.
driverChargeStaffReadOnly: Notices, reviews, scheduling and deductions are recorded on the web. This screen shows them read only.
driverChargeNoActions: No action is waiting for you on this charge.
driverChargeStatusIssued: Issued, not yet sent to you
driverChargeReplaced: This charge was cancelled as wrongly issued and replaced by another charge.
handoverAuthSignerHint: Needed only when the driver was not picked from the driver register.
handoverAuthHandingFirst: The handing driver signs first, then the receiving driver.
handoverAuthFrozen: Signed record. The content is locked and can no longer be changed.
handoverAuthLocationNone: No location recorded yet. It is recorded with each signature.
handoverAuthOffline: You are offline. A handover signature is recorded only online, so nothing was saved. Connect and try again.
handoverAuthSigned: Signature recorded with the server time.
handoverAuthSigningStepInfo: Both drivers sign on the handover page after you save it, while online. Each signature is stamped with the server time and the device location, and the record is locked after the first signature.
handoverAuthOpenToSign: The handover is saved as a draft. Open it now to collect both signatures.
handoverAuthLegacySignature: Driver signature recorded before two-party signing
handoverAuthNotAvailable: Two-party signing is not available on the server yet. Ask an administrator.
handoverAuthOnBehalf: I am signing on behalf of {name}
handoverAuthOnBehalfRequired: Confirm that you are signing on behalf of this person.
handoverAuthBlocked: Your account is linked to the other driver on this handover, so you cannot sign for this party. Leave this signature for the driver or a supervisor.
handoverAuthSignedOnBehalf: Signed on their behalf by a supervisor
handoverAuthSentBack: Sent back for correction. The signatures were cleared. Correct the handover and sign again.
handoverAuthBadSignature: The signature could not be read. Clear it and sign again.
driverChargeWitnessIntro: You were named as the witness to the driver refusing to sign this notice. Confirm only what you saw yourself.
driverChargeWitnessPending: Refusal recorded. Waiting for the named witness to confirm it from their own account.
driverChargeWitnessSaved: Your witness confirmation was recorded with the server time.
handoverAuthReceivingOtherAccount: You gave the handing signature on this device account. The receiving signature must come from another person: the receiving driver's own account or a different supervisor.
handoverAuthSiteRequired: Enter the site. This vehicle has no site in the fleet register.
handoverAuthSiteFromRegister: Taken from the fleet register for this vehicle.
signatureSignAgain: The signature is too short to be read. Please sign again with your full signature.
driverChargeLinkUnverified: Link to source not confirmed by record
driverChargeAppealClosedDeducted: Deductions have started, so this charge can no longer be appealed here. A manager or finance can waive the remainder.
